2122017061912092795.en_summary: Canada’s real estate crisis is real, and the risks could be much bigger than many people are prepared for. Buyers are disappearing, homes sitting on market, affordability stretched, job losses adding pressure. Energy-driven inflation risk pushing rates higher or keeping costs elevated. Dangerous combination of falling demand, declining purchasing power, mortgage renewals, unemployment and highly leveraged households. 2008 reminder of how quickly confidence disappears. Biggest risk is when people can no longer afford to hold homes bought at yesterday’s prices. Housing market doesn’t need crash in single day; only buyers to disappear and forced sellers to show up.
2122017061912092795.zh_summary: 加拿大的房地產危機是真實的，風險可能比許多人準備的要大得多。買家消失，房屋滯留市場，可負擔性緊張，失業增加壓力。能源驅動通脹風險推高利率或維持借貸成本高企。需求下降、購買力下降、抵押續期、失業和高槓桿家庭的危險組合。2008年提醒信心消失有多快。最大風險是當人們再也負擔不起以昨天價格購買的房屋。住房市場不需要單日崩盤；只需要買家消失和被迫賣家出現。

2122016412453486993.en_summary: Money illusion hides the slow erosion of fiat such as the paper $. Printed endlessly by central banks, its value trends toward zero over the very long run. Gradual inflation (2-8%/yr) masks this depreciation—most don't notice until the erosion accelerates. Acceleration could again happen soon due to $40T in debts. (Quoting LukeGromen on gold price action scaring investors.)
